name: Peach Blossom Fan
subtitle: Nhat Tan Petal Spray
mechanism: Turret (LotusShooter targeting). Each shot is petal_count peach_petal projectiles spread spread_deg apart around the aim line, so an enemy staggering off the line (Bia Hoi Zombie, +-0.8 m) still meets a petal.

abilities.name: Petal Fan
abilities.effect: Flings 3 petals (12 damage each) 8 deg apart.

clipAnnotations.idle: The big blossom nods on its branch.
clipAnnotations.attack: Blossom folds back, then snaps open (petals leave at 0.24 s).
clipAnnotations.die: Squash and shrink into the pot.
